Commentary.Commentary: Now the score is a very small one and Sri Lanka will back themselves to chase this down quite easily. Zimbabwe on the other hand, have been brilliant so far in this tournament and have won games from difficult situation. Their bowlers though will have to put in a once in a lifetime performance here. Can they do so? We will find out.

Yet another excellent bowling performance from Lanka! Another side which has not crossed the 200-run mark against them. It was Dilshan Madushanka who began it all but getting three with the new ball. Then there was a decent partnership betwee, Raza and Sean Williams which got their side back into the game. Sean Williams scored another fifty. Once Raza fell though it was a procession. Maheesh Theekshana ran through the middle order and Matheesha Pathirana made quick work of the lower-order. Overall, Lanka are well and truly on top at the halfway mark.

OUT! TIMBER! That is the end of the innings. Maheesh Theekshana gets 4. On middle, this one lands and holds its line. Blessing Muzarabani looks to swing but misses and it hits the stumps. ZIMBABWE HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 165!
